verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a broad programmatic surface: a versioned REST API, a GraphQL API with a published schema, and a stable OpenAPI description. Fine-grained token permissions map to individual endpoints, and the official CLI and MCP server bring PRs, issues, Actions and other features outside the UI. However, no evidence asserts or demonstrates that every UI action has an API equivalent, so the extent of parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or coverage map showing UI-to-API parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no UI-only features exist.
